bgp 65000
 group EXTERNAL external
  peer EXTERNAL as-number 65001
  peer EXTERNAL description "External BGP peers"
  peer EXTERNAL import-route-policy IMPORT_POLICY
  peer EXTERNAL export-route-policy EXPORT_POLICY
 peer 10.0.0.2 as-number 65001
 peer 10.0.0.2 group EXTERNAL
 peer 10.0.0.2 description "Primary external peer"
 peer 10.0.0.2 password cipher $c$3$xxx
 peer 192.168.1.1 as-number 65002
 peer 192.168.1.1 description "Standalone peer"
 #
 address-family ipv4
  peer EXTERNAL enable
  peer 10.0.0.2 enable
  peer 192.168.1.1 enable
  peer EXTERNAL route-policy IMPORT_POLICY import
  peer EXTERNAL route-policy EXPORT_POLICY export
  peer 10.0.0.2 route-policy PEER_IMPORT import
  peer 10.0.0.2 route-policy PEER_EXPORT export
 #
